Title: VDB - online card search & deck building tool

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
Hi All,
I'm pleased to announce you new online card search & deck-building tool - VDB  vdb.im .
It's a successor of  VTES-DB , it's similar in look, but it use new engine allowing new features - most important of which is Deck Building.

Features:
- Combined deck building & search interface - browse & add cards to your decks on-the-fly;
- Wide search options - many filters (essentials + useful e.g. set / precons / artist with traits like 'only in' and 'first printed in' for sets);
- Interface which you may like (or not
- Mobile-friendly. Should look nice on modern big mobile screens (may not fit entirely into smaller though);
- Import/export to/from popular formats to easy migration and backup - e.g. you can paste text from TWDA/Amaranth/Lacket (or import from file) to quickly start with your decks;
- Create PDF with proxies of your decks;
- Updated to V5;
- Open source, ad-free & privacy-respecting;

Usage hints:
- You will need to create account for deck building (as it stores decks on the server). No email confirmations, etc required - just name and password. You can use card search without account of course.
- Hover over card name to preview image.
- Click on card name to toggle preview from image to text and back (useful for lower bandwidth / easier reading).
- You can edit deck in dedicated Deck tab, or (what is advised) modify it on-the-fly during card search: to do so, go to Crypt/Library search (login & create deck first) and click top-left 'Add to Deck Mode', then all cards results of you searches will have '+' button to add it to chosen deck. You can toggle this mode (as well as change 'active' deck) anytime.
- On mobile cards in 'Add mode' are added to the deck selected in Deck tab (you can switch tabs without losing results/filters).
- On mobile 'Magnifying glass' button on top-right corner toggle from search form to results and back.

The idea behind adding/changing cards in the inventory is (in addition to full-deck-add):
1) You add new card by the name from the field in the top. If you don't already have this card it will be added with 1 quantity. If you already have it, quantity will not change.
In both cases (you have it or it newly added) card will additionally appear (to it's natural place in inventory list) on the top for the convenience (so you don't need to look for it in the long list to change quantity, see below).
2) You change card quantity clicking [-] and [+] (in main inventory list OR newly spawned card line after you just add it).

Please let me know if this approach is OK.
I'm already thinking how to handle big changes. Optios are: +/-5 buttons, manual quantity enter, etc, I will test how it will affect interface and introduce it later (I want to keep interface as clean as possible from barely useful items).

Another update:

Deck revisions description:
For each your deck it's possible to create 'revisions', which are decks hidden from main deck select box, but can be selected from revision selection box (will spawn next to deck selection box after you create first revision).
Revisions share author/name between each other, but cards/descriptions are different.
Each revision has it's unique url and you can share them separately from each other (without giving access to other revisions of the deck).
Deleting of the deck delete all revisions.
Cloning from revision create separate deck (which can has its own revisions, of course), same as cloning any other deck.
Inventory status for each revision is different and has impact on calculation of required cards, you have to manage it by yourself for now (i.e. let unused revisions have virtual (@) status and only set 'main' to required inventory status). Later I'll figure out how to optimize it.

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
>Is there somewhere an explanation, what exactly the percentages in the "simulated hand" represent?

Chance to draw the card if you hand is still in the deck (and you hand size is equal to what you have at given moment), but discarded cards are not in the deck. So it's not a chance to draw additional card to existing hand, but chance to draw the hand in the first place. Chances are for 1 pc only, hover over chance if you want to see for 2+.

For the suggestion, I will test how it will looks like. Not sure I can fit it nicely to draw window (it does not go into main deck window anyway as it's not that important).

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
Search by card text is powered by Regular Expressions (particularly Python implementation, but it's mostly universal) and will search for correct pattern.

Examples (excluding doublequotes):
1) "minion.*strike" will search for any appearance of "minion" followed by anything (even nothing or several sentenses) followed by "strike".
2) "add . blood" will search for any appearance of "add X blood" (where X is a single symbol, so can be "X", "0", "5" but not "10").

Short intruduction is here in sections "Basic Patterns" and "Repetition" (should be enough for 95% cases): developers.google.com/edu/python/regular-expressions
More information: docs.python.org/3/howto/regex.html

I know it's not very user-friendly, but it requires very small maintenance from my side and still let users to do very complicated searches.

Another update to VDB:
- Add Public Deck Archive (PDA) page. In Beta (see below)!
- Small other fixes

Important notes:
PDA IS BETA FEATURE AND MAY BE UNSTABLE. PLEASE BACKUP (EXPORT) YOUR DECKS BEFORE USING IT (and don't hesitate to contact me if things goes wrong for you).

This feature is very complicated for me to handle (from both design and development skills perspective), it will likely to be fixed/changed/improved in the future, but some 'obvious' features (like comments or other forms of communication) may be delayed indefinitely.

Public Deck Archive (PDA) let you share your decks with other players and search other players shared decks
Following concepts are behind PDA:
- Public it can be searched (using similar set of filters as for TWDA), viewed, copied by other players in the PDA page, and can be deleted by the author (but as with any other deck, author cannot delete your copy of the deck made with Copy deck button)
- Public Deck is created from one of your existing deck (parent) in the Decks page using Public Archive button
- You can switch to/from your public (child) and parent deck using Public Archive button in Deck page, with Public deck
- Public deck is non-editable with standard card buttons. The only way to update Public Deck is to sync it with the parent deck using Public Archive button in Deck page. It does not automatically follows updates of the parent deck
- We encourage people to mostly leave the deck unchanged after publishing. For significant changes please create new deck (feel free to use Description to give cross-references between sister decks and/or give any explanation you want)
- Author can remove the deck from PDA anytime, but each re-add creates new copy of the deck and it will be listed again (not available for those who add it to Favorites before deletion)
- Deck author name is public author name (same you see in Deck view page), it is not unique (no ownership), can be different from your account name and can be changed anytime

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
There is no specific feature to check your inventory against entire cards pool, but...

You can use this synthetic "decks" containing 1x of each card: gist.github.com/smeea/99959177b9ffc47b5bf9043c61c923a2
1) Import them to your decks
2) Give some Fixed (pin icon) inventory status
3) You will see them in Missing in the inventory page
4) Delete this decks when you dont need them anymore, or simply Hide them and switch off inventory status to Virtual (@).

P.S. It's not "zero vs blank" but more like "existing entry with 0 qty vs non-existing entry".
Think of this as side-deck approach in Decks: you can leave some cards to be there with 0 q-ty for your convenience. Clicking [-] again will remove them completely from your inventory (like it was never added).
You will still see empty red-boxes for filters "All or Only Problems" because there are problems with that cards, but you will see such 0 q-ty cards even in Only owned filter (and they will dissapear once you click [-]).

Messages.Body: What would be the easiest way to import an existing collection into VDB?

Messages.Author: smeeag
Messages.Body:
I replied to you by email, but in case there are others interested:
Importing from text is the simplest, so if you are coming to VDB from something else that will be the way.
All you need is txt with cards in the following format, new card each line:
1x Card Name
2x Card Name
...

Cards with "The Name" should be "Name, The" instead. E.g. "Unmasking, The" or "Unnamed, The".

For crypt:
"Advanced" must have (ADV) after name
For different groups under same name add (GX) after card name where X is group
